description: List a store's transactions (orders), newest first. Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:transactions. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/transactions.

customer_email.description: Filter by the transaction's customer email.

is_test.description: Filter to test (true) or live (false) transactions.

store_id.description: Store id. If omitted, the default store (fx:store) is used.

zoom.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed, e.g. 'items,customer,payments'.

name: foxy_list_transactions
title: List transactions
